title: Among all carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one triple bond, fin
question: Among all carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one triple bond, find those where the average number of bonds per carbon atom exceeds 1.5. Return the molecule ID and this average.

prediction.sql: SELECT m."XCL_010" AS molecule_id, CAST(COUNT(b."XCL_004") AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT a."XCL_001") AS avg_bonds_per_carbon FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m."XCL_010" = a."XCL_002" INNER JOIN bond AS b ON a."XCL_002" = b."XCL_005" WHERE m."XCL_011" = '+' AND a."XCL_003" = 'c' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond AS tb WHERE tb."XCL_005" = m."XCL_010" AND tb."XCL_006" = '#') GROUP BY m."XCL_010" HAVING CAST(COUNT(b."XCL_004") AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT a."XCL_001") > 1.5

    m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.XCL_009) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) AS avg_bonds_per_carbon
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
JOIN connected c ON a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_007 OR a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_008
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
  AND a.XCL_003 = 'c'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM bond b2 
      WHERE b2.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010 
        AND b2.XCL_006 = '#'
  )
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.XCL_009) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) > 1.5
